notice: All profile, post, issuer and price content is synthetic. The runner uses temporary local files and makes no network requests.

cases.request: Backtest @fixturealpha over the supplied synthetic period, including inferred and explicit views.
cases.pass: Hand-calculated raw and market-relative outcomes, denominators, means and security counts match.

cases.request: Use the stated conservative entry rule even when required prices are missing.
cases.pass: Friday publication enters Monday; missing exit remains unscored; later incomplete windows remain pending.

cases.request: Review every source post, including those with no directional view.
cases.pass: Every source ID appears once in reviews; missing or duplicate review rows are rejected.

cases.request: Preserve authored evidence and reject paraphrases substituted as quotations.
cases.pass: Evidence absent from the source and altered full post text are rejected.

cases.request: Keep corporate actions separate unless the same security is verified.
cases.pass: Wrong-date issuer evidence and an alias chain without same-security proof are rejected; verified aliases share repeat and balance grouping.

cases.request: Score the frozen source classifications rather than edits made after validation.
cases.pass: Changed calls, source posts, post reviews or study plan are rejected by actual run_backtest before scoring.

cases.request: Report the absence of scoreable calls without inventing a result.
cases.pass: Empty and macro-only fixtures produce zero scored events and null hit rate/mean.

cases.request: Keep session horizons fixed even if the benchmark feed has a gap.
cases.pass: Independent supplied calendar catches an omitted SPY session and scoring refuses to proceed.

cases.request: Use the skill to backtest an X handle over a user-specified period and produce an institutional PDF.
cases.pass: A reviewer can locate intake, source classification, required data access, deterministic scoring, report production, disclosures and delivery without inventing credentials or historical data.
